sourceTitle: Wenderholme: A Story of Lancashire and Yorkshire
description: "Wenderholme: A Story of Lancashire and Yorkshire" by Philip Gilbert Hamerton is a novel written in the late 19th century. The book explores the lives of families in the regions of Lancashire and Yorkshire, focusing on the contrasts between different social classes and the changes in their lifestyles over time.
